revisions: Equation 15 prints C=-(ln L+P), while the prose says C decreases as the positive fitting error improves and stops when the next C increases; sign, optimization direction, and stopping rule are internally inconsistent without an unstated convention
the criterion is AIC-inspired and empirically selected, not standard AIC; no held-out criterion-selection set or BIC result is reported
detection rate is detected-count divided by true-count, can exceed 100 percent, and is not precision or recall
angular and presence errors are conditional on correctly matched detected reflections and omit misses and extra peaks
measured 13-reflection labels are second-order ISM predictions and may omit higher-order, scattered, or diffracted arrivals
source_updates.limited_conclusion: Promising localization-map candidate; unattended echo-count claims are blocked until the published sign/stopping convention and full TP/FP/FN accounting are independently verified.

source_updates.title: Parametric Resynthesis of Measured Spatial Room Impulse Responses
findings: Herglotz detection is used inside an end-to-end early-reflection and DFDN late-field resynthesis chain
detailed paper evidence is one EM32 measurement in IRCAM Espro evaluated by spherical correlation and binaural EDR-difference figures
there is no controlled listening test, released implementation, multi-room statistical table, or CPU/latency benchmark
the paper acknowledges finite-order missed reflections, adjacent-beam energy overestimation, and single-slope late-decay limits
source_updates.limited_conclusion: Objective downstream resynthesis evidence exists but is dependent same-family evidence and does not resolve detector-count reproducibility or establish perceptual superiority.

revisions: the method avoids a separate localizer at inference but training includes explicit ground-truth DOA loss and the paper reports DOA error
the paper does not state speaker-disjoint, utterance-disjoint, or room-geometry-disjoint splits
NMSE and ILD/ITD are both training objectives and evaluation measures, so those objective results are partially coupled to the loss
fixed-baseline parameters are selected on 50 high-DRR scenarios whose train-validation-test provenance is not reported
the declared MUSHRA screens contain a hidden reference and three algorithms but no described dedicated low-quality anchor
non-significance against the reference in one low-DRR scene is not equivalence
source_updates.limited_conclusion: Explicitly DOA-supervised adaptive binaural renderer evaluated on simulated single-source speech; not localization-free and not validated for real multi-source music.

source_updates.title: Field-of-View Informed Binaural Signal Matching for Head-Worn Arrays
findings: Monte Carlo evaluation covers 200 simulated 16-kHz sets with one to three TIMIT speakers, diffuse babble, four room or DRR conditions, and inside versus outside FoV groupings
COMPASS-BSM receives ground-truth DOAs and ATFs and is an oracle best-case comparator
listening uses 16 participants, four simulated single-talker conditions, a hidden HOA reference, BSM as lower anchor, and BS.1770-2 loudness equalization
listening is limited to sources inside the FoV, static binaural playback, simulated speech, and no head tracking
shared authors, BSM formulation, HRTF or array assumptions, and research lineage make this supporting family evidence rather than independent replication
source_updates.limited_conclusion: Fixed FoV can reallocate reproduction error toward a chosen frontal region in the tested simulated wearable-array domain; it does not independently validate neural adaptation, moving scenes, music, or stereo-mix controls.

knowledge_cards: The printed Herglotz information criterion and stopping direction are mutually inconsistent unless a sign or optimization convention is missing.
A detected-count ratio is not recall; values above 100 percent require explicit false-positive accounting.
Conditional angular and presence errors over matched detections must be paired with miss and extra-peak rates.
ISM-derived directions in a measured room are model-assisted labels rather than direct physical ground truth.
Same-group downstream resynthesis is extension evidence, not an independent detector replication.
Spherical correlation and EDR fit do not establish perceptual quality, peak safety, or musical suitability.
FoV-BSM-Net is explicitly DOA-supervised despite omitting a separate inference localizer.
Random scenario splitting within three fixed simulated rooms does not establish speaker, utterance, or geometry generalization.
Training on NMSE and ILD/ITD partially couples those objective metrics to the optimization target.
A fixed baseline selected on 50 scenarios of unreported split provenance needs a declared selection split.
A MUSHRA label does not replace a described low-quality anchor, screening, and predefined contrasts.
Fixed and neural FoV publications are one BSM/FoV evidence family, not two independent confirmations.
